ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle inscribed in a rectangle/square frame, and the circle is tangent to the left and right vertical sides. The top horizontal dimension arrow extends from the left vertical side to the right vertical side, labeled as 9 mm. Reasoning: This horizontal distance is the diameter of the circle, so d = 9 mm. The formula for the circumference of a circle is C = πd, therefore C = π × 9 = 9π mm.
